data.body_html:
When booking a Marbella yacht charter, knowing your payment options can save time and hassle. In 2032, we offer three main methods: bank transfer, credit card, and cryptocurrency. Whether you're reserving the Astondoa 40 for a sunset cruise from Puerto Banús or the Mangusta 80 for a day trip to Cabopino, each method has its pros. This guide breaks down the accepted options, deposit requirements, and what to expect — so you can focus on the Mediterranean, not the paperwork.

Bank Transfer: The Standard Choice

Bank transfer remains the most common payment method for Marbella yacht charter bookings. For Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h), a 50% deposit via SEPA or SWIFT secures your date. The balance is due 7 days before departure. International transfers typically take 1–3 business days, so plan accordingly. All payments include 21% Spanish IVA, skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks — no surprises.

Credit Card Payments: Fast and Flexible

We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express for deposits and final payments on most yachts. This is ideal for last-minute bookings or when you want instant confirmation. For Tier B yachts such as the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, from €4,719/4h) or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), credit card payments may include a small processing fee (typically 2–3%). Always confirm via WhatsApp before paying to avoid surprises. Credit cards are also accepted for the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) and Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax).

Cryptocurrency: Bitcoin and Ethereum for 2032

For tech-savvy clients, we accept Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) for all charters in 2032. This is perfect for international guests who want to avoid bank fees or exchange rate fluctuations. Simply book via WhatsApp and we'll lock the exchange rate at the time of confirmation. Crypto payments are accepted for all boats, including the Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) and Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax). The full amount is required upfront to secure the booking.

Deposit and Balance Schedule

For all charters, a 50% deposit is required to confirm your reservation. The remaining 50% is due 7 days before your departure. For bookings made within 7 days of the charter date, full payment is required at the time of booking. This applies to all yachts in our fleet, from the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) to the K80 (24m, 12 pax). We send a detailed invoice via email with all payment instructions.

What's Included in Your Payment?

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish IVA. No hidden fees. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed per session. For Tier B and larger yachts (e.g., Mangusta 80 Grey at 24m, 12 pax), pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Gratuities for the crew are optional but appreciated.

Payment for Special Charters

For large groups or special events (e.g., weddings, corporate outings), we can arrange custom payment plans. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss split payments, multiple invoices, or deferred payment schedules. This is particularly useful for the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), which are popular for luxury events along the Golden Mile.

Currency and Exchange Rates

All payments are processed in Euros (EUR). For international clients, your bank will handle the conversion at their rate. For crypto payments, we use the market rate at the time of booking confirmation. We recommend checking current exchange rates to avoid surprises. For clients from the UK, US, or UAE, bank transfers are straightforward via SWIFT.

Security and Privacy

We take payment security seriously. Bank transfers go to our corporate account. Credit card payments are processed through a PCI-compliant gateway. Crypto payments use a secure wallet address provided via WhatsApp. We never store your payment details after the transaction. For Marbella yacht charter bookings, your financial data is protected under Spanish data protection laws.

Cancellation and Refund Policy

Cancellations made 14+ days before the charter receive a full refund (minus any bank fees). Cancellations 7–13 days before incur a 50% charge. Within 7 days, no refund is given. For crypto payments, refunds are processed in the same cryptocurrency at the current market rate. We recommend travel insurance to cover unforeseen circumstances.
